risk_if_not_implemented: Without Asset Monitoring and Tracking, malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to natural threats NT-2, NT-3, NT-4, NT-5, NT-6, NT-8, NT-11, NT-12, NT-13, NT-14; man-made threats MT-5, MT-6, MT-7, MT-9, MT-10, MT-12, MT-14.

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Asset Monitoring and Tracking (PES-19) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Asset Inventories
compensating_control_2.justification: Asset Inventories (AST-04) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Asset Monitoring and Tracking (PES-19) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Facility applicability. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
